description:
Create, list, show and delete person files at people/<Name>.md. People are the targets of note attendees and task assignees. They are not threads.

Subcommands:
  list [QUERY] [--all] [--json] — list people, open only by default
  show PERSON [--json] — show one person file
  new --name NAME --category CATEGORY — create a person file
  delete PERSON -y — permanently delete a person file

Args:
  QUERY: optional fuzzy search; results are ranked by similarity.
  PERSON: full name, matching the filename without .md.

Flags:
  list:
    --all   also show closed people
    --json   JSON output
  show:
    --json   JSON output
  new:
    --name NAME   required; full name; becomes the filename; must not contain '/' or start with '.'
    --category   required; professional, personal or voluntary
  delete:
    -y, --yes   required to confirm the delete

Examples:
  ["list", "riaz"]
  ["show", "Riaz Arbi", "--json"]
  ["new", "--name", "Riaz Arbi", "--category", "professional"]

Notes:
  delete is permanent. Without -y it refuses and exits 1.
  Exit 1: empty name, a name containing '/' or starting with '.', the person already exists, person not found, or delete without -y.

BLOCKED: delete. These subcommands are refused and calling one returns an error. Do not attempt them.
